field_edits.updated_text: The left posterior tibial vein demonstrates echogenic intraluminal thrombus, is non‑compressible, and is partially patent with minimal residual color flow, consistent with acute deep venous thrombosis. The left common femoral vein, femoral vein, profunda femoris vein and popliteal vein are normally compressible and demonstrate normal color flow and spectral venous waveforms. No thrombus is seen in the proximal deep venous system.

impression: 1. Acute deep venous thrombosis of the left posterior tibial vein (calf vein DVT) with partial residual luminal patency, no extension into the popliteal or femoropopliteal venous system.
